entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: A hidden cavern beneath the Teeth of Akoum on Zendikar, the focal point of the prison binding the Eldrazi, which can only be reopened by three planeswalker sparks and Ugin's breath.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which the Eldrazi were imprisoned.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: The volcanic mountains of Zendikar beneath which the Eye lies.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrosities from the Blind Eternities that consume planes, imprisoned on Zendikar and later released.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who lured the Eldrazi to Zendikar and later takes Nissa and Anowon to the Eye.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A Kor lithomancer and planeswalker native to Zendikar who built the hedron network and restores the prison alone.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ageless Spirit Dragon planeswalker, originally an Elder Dragon, who bound the Eldrazi with colorless magic and rebuilds the chamber.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: A network of stone hedrons that channels Zendikar's leylines to form the bars of the Eldrazi prison.

entities.name: Imprisonment of the Eldrazi
entities.description: The compromise by which the three planeswalkers bound the Eldrazi on Zendikar rather than kill them.

entities.name: Release of the Eldrazi
entities.description: Nissa's shattering of the main hedron, which frees the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A Zendikari people who revere garbled versions of Nahiri's teachings as the gods Talib, Kamsa and Mangeni.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who manipulates events and sends Sarkhan Vol to guard the Eye.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker sent by Bolas to guard the Eye.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who finds the Eye and unknowingly loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who chases Chandra to the Eye and later learns how the hedrons might be used to kill the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A vampire who guides Jace and Chandra, and is later liberated by Sorin.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker of Zendikar who shatters the main hedron, releasing the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: Gideon's merfolk friend who finds clues about leylines and hedrons.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The place where Jace returns to pass information to Gideon.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The place between planes from which the Eldrazi come.

events.summary: Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin ally against the Eldrazi but cannot defeat them, and instead imprison them on Zendikar with a hedron network centered on the Eye of Ugin.
events.quote: Instead of killing the Eldrazi, they caused the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

events.summary: The three planeswalkers seal the Eye with a lock that needs three planeswalker sparks and Ugin's breath, then disband.
events.quote: Their mission complete, the planeswalkers disbanded.

events.summary: Vampires build a shrine near the Eye, destabilizing the prison; Nahiri awakens, calls for help in vain, restores the prison alone, then leaves to find Sorin.
events.quote: She succeeded on her own, and restored the prison.

events.summary: Bolas sends Sarkhan to guard the Eye; Chandra and Jace, guided by Anowon, confront him there, and Chandra's invisible flame spell loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.
events.quote: thus unknowingly loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi

events.summary: Sorin returns, frees Anowon and goes with Nissa to the Eye, where Nissa shatters the main hedron, releasing the Eldrazi; Sorin leaves the plane.
events.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

events.summary: Jace and Jori En go to the Eye, where Ugin is rebuilding the network; Jace sees the hedrons could be used to kill the Eldrazi and leaves despite Ugin's warnings.
events.quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye

relations.note: Allied with Nahiri and Ugin to imprison the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Sorin decided to ally with two other planeswalkers

relations.note: One of the three imprisoning planeswalkers.
relations.quote: Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone hedrons

relations.note: One of the three imprisoning planeswalkers.
relations.quote: Sorin lured the Eldrazi to the plane
Nicol Bolas became aware of the Eye and sent Sarkhan Vol to guard it

relations.note: Served as guide to Jace and Chandra.
relations.quote: The vampire Anowon served as a guide for both Jace and Chandra

relations.note: Betrayed his plan by shattering the hedron.
relations.quote: Sorin washed his hands of her and the entire plane.
deep beneath the volcanic Teeth of Akoum on the plane of Zendikar
